name: QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 Pioneer (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated)
description: The QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 Pioneer is the fully-loaded build of QiYi's M Pro V3 line — a magnetic speed cube that pairs an integrated ball-core with core-to-corner magnetic positioning, edge-corner magnets, and a UV diamond-coated finish. If you want every bit of stability and speed this platform can deliver, this is the version to reach for.
features: Diamond-coated shine: The UV coating stays glossy and holds its premium look through extended use, resisting wear and scratches.
Dial in your feel: The visual dual-adjustment system takes tuning out of guesswork territory and puts it on a numbered scale you can read at a glance.
8-level axis distance: Rotate the circular-hole indicator counterclockwise — the larger the number showing, the tighter the axis distance.
8-level elasticity: Rotate the triangular indicator clockwise — the larger the number, the stronger the elasticity.
Visual multi-point star dial: Color-coded numbered indicators let you see your exact setting instead of counting turns, so you can repeat a setup you like.
Integrated high-strength core: Keeps axis distance consistent across all six faces for a uniform, harmonious turning feel and no broken-core worries.
